categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies connection management logic in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant outbound connections caused by racing manual connection attempts. Fixes #5299, an open issue from 2014 where overlapping startup parameters or concurrent 'addnode onetry' commands race past m_nodes duplicate checks before connections complete.
